services.hero.title: Our Services
services.hero.subtitle: Dedicated to spiritual growth, devotion, and service to humanity
services.religious.title: Religious & Spiritual Activities
services.religious.intro: The organization actively conducts and organizes various spiritual and religious programs to inspire devotion, moral values, and spiritual awareness among devotees.
services.religious.ramkatha.title: Shri Ram Katha
services.religious.ramkatha.desc: Regular spiritual discourses on the life and teachings of Lord Ram, inspiring devotion and righteous living.
services.religious.bhagwat.title: Shrimad Bhagwat Katha
services.religious.bhagwat.desc: Sacred recitations and discourses from the Bhagavata Purana, guiding devotees on the path of bhakti.
services.religious.yagya.title: Yagya & Hawan Ceremonies
services.religious.yagya.desc: Traditional Vedic fire rituals performed for spiritual purification and divine blessings.
services.religious.aarti.title: Daily Aarti and Satsang
services.religious.aarti.desc: Morning and evening prayer ceremonies with spiritual gatherings for devotees and seekers.
services.religious.camps.title: Spiritual Camps
services.religious.camps.desc: Special camps during Kumbh & Magh Mela providing spiritual guidance and services to pilgrims.
services.religious.festivals.title: Festival Celebrations
services.religious.festivals.desc: Vibrant celebrations of Hindu festivals based on the traditional calendar with devotional programs.
services.annadan.title: Annadan & Humanitarian Services
services.annadan.intro: Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram believes that "Annadan is Mahadan" (food donation is the greatest charity)
services.annadan.meals.title: Free Meal Distribution
services.annadan.meals.desc: Regular free meals for saints, sadhus, and devotees visiting the ashram
services.annadan.katha.title: Annadan During Katha
services.annadan.katha.desc: Food service during spiritual discourse programs and religious gatherings
services.annadan.kumbh.title: Kumbh Mela Service
services.annadan.kumbh.desc: Large-scale food distribution during Kumbh Mela and major festivals
services.annadan.bhog.title: 56 Bhog Offerings
services.annadan.bhog.desc: Special prasad offerings on auspicious occasions and festivals
services.annadan.blanket.title: Blanket Donation
services.annadan.blanket.desc: Winter blanket distribution drives during Kumbh Mela in Prayagraj
services.annadan.family.title: Family Support
services.annadan.family.desc: Assistance for needy families during religious gatherings and events
services.gaushala.title: Gaushala & Dharma Seva
services.gaushala.intro: Cow protection and Gaushala Seva form an essential part of the Ashram's mission. The organization promotes traditional values of cow care and preservation as described in Sanatan scriptures.
services.cta.title: Join Us in Service
services.cta.desc: Become part of our mission to serve humanity through devotion, spiritual learning, and selfless service
